name: Bolvar Fordragon
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Bolvar Fordragon holds the crown and armies while King Varian is missing. As Regent and Supreme Commander of Stormwind’s armed forces, he stands beside young King Anduin and struggles to hold the kingdom together. Troubles at home grow, while Lady Katrana Prestor’s counsel often delays his military decisions.

sections.title: Regent of the Realm
sections.body:
King Varian vanished while traveling to a peace summit on Theramore Isle, leaving Stormwind in disarray. Ten-year-old Prince Anduin was crowned to preserve continuity, and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon took up the work of ruling as Regent.

A venerated paladin devoted to the crown, Bolvar now faces a kingdom under strain. Stormwind’s soldiers are spread thin across Westfall, Redridge, and Duskwood. Lady Katrana Prestor dismisses his concerns and repeatedly blocks him from sending royal troops to frontier towns.

sections.title: A Web of Deceit
sections.body:
Town magistrates and frontier marshals plead for reinforcements against the Defias Brotherhood and Blackrock orcs. Lady Prestor quietly shapes royal decrees and belittles every report of danger. Bolvar respects the counsel of the nobility, so he hesitates to act without undeniable proof. Unwittingly, he leaves the crown unable to act.

When compelling evidence arrives, the Regent sets court custom aside. Warnings from investigators in Theramore or news of missing field officers can move him to turn to independent adventurers.

faq.q: Why is Bolvar ruling instead of King Varian?
faq.answer: King Varian Wrynn disappeared under suspicious circumstances while sailing to a diplomatic summit at Theramore Isle. His ten-year-old son Anduin was crowned to preserve political order. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon became Regent, governing the kingdom and commanding its armies until Varian is found.

faq.q: Why won't Bolvar send soldiers to help Redridge or Westfall?
faq.answer: Stormwind’s standing armies are stretched thin guarding its core territories and borders. Lady Katrana Prestor, Bolvar’s chief advisor, repeatedly questions reports from places such as Lakeshire, calls them exaggerations, and counsels against sending royal forces. Without military proof, Bolvar instead deputizes independent adventurers to intervene.

faq.q: What is Bolvar's relationship with Lady Katrana Prestor?
aliases: who is lady prestor to bolvar
faq.answer: Lady Katrana Prestor is the foremost royal councilor to Stormwind’s throne. Bolvar respects her political judgment and knowledge of noble affairs, yet she continually urges restraint and counsels him to dismiss reports of dragons, orcs, and Defias plots.

faq.q: What is Bolvar's connection to young Prince Anduin?
faq.answer: Bolvar is not related to Anduin, but he is the young king’s fierce protector, guardian, and mentor. He stands beside Anduin’s throne in Stormwind Keep, shielding him from court intrigue and keeping the Wrynn dynasty secure until Varian returns.

angles.text: As a paladin, Bolvar embodies the Alliance’s martial ideal: devotion to the Light and unwavering duty to his people, even as political schemes mount.
As Supreme Commander of Stormwind, Bolvar leads the human military and balances local rebellions against the Alliance’s wider obligations.
